errors.rustAnalyzerNotFound: The code helper (rust-analyzer) isn't installed. Suggestions and live problems are off.

firstRun.welcome: Welcome to VizcachaIDE. Let's get you writing code in under a minute.
legacy.a_go_program_starts_running_4b1fd: A Go program starts running in the function main of package main. This package is called main, but it does not contain a function named main.
legacy.add_a_function_with_exactly_dcc21: Add a function with exactly this header: func main() '{''{' ... '}''}'
legacy.add_a_return_statement_at_8eb595: Add a return statement at the end of the function, or an else branch that also returns a value.
legacy.add_or_remove_values_so_b7f95b: Add or remove values so there is one per verb, or use fmt.Println if you do not need formatting.
legacy.add_or_remove_variables_until_a5f: Add or remove variables until both sides match, for example: number, err := strconv.Atoi(text). Use _ for a value you do not need.
legacy.additional_environment_variables_: Additional environment variables, one per line: NAME=VALUE
legacy.all_goroutines_are_blocked_waitin: All goroutines are blocked waiting for each other, so nothing can continue. Usually a channel is sent to with nobody receiving, or received from with nobody sending, or a WaitGroup or Mutex is never released.
legacy.arguments_passed_to_your_program_: Arguments passed to your program (os.Args), separated by spaces. Use quotes to keep words together.
legacy.change_the_first_line_to_515fc4: Change the first line to: package main (and make sure there is a func main).
legacy.check_that_the_divisor_is_b38611: Check that the divisor is not 0 before dividing, for example: if people != 0 '{''{' ... '}''}'.
legacy.check_the_index_before_using_aebe: Check the index before using it (for example: if i < len(items)) and remember that counting starts at 0.
legacy.check_the_spelling_and_the_8fed2b: Check the spelling and the capital letters, declare the variable before you use it (for example with :=), or import the package it belongs to.
legacy.check_the_spelling_of_the_88b57e: Check the spelling of the import path. For an external package, run go get {package} in a folder that has a go.mod file.
legacy.click_to_go_to_this_53b411: Click to go to this line
legacy.compiling_your_program_the_first_: Compiling your program... The first run after installing can take a minute.
legacy.convert_one_side_so_both_d40a26: Convert one side so both have the same type, for example strconv.Itoa(n) to turn an int into a string, or float64(n) to mix it with decimals.
legacy.could_not_read_from_the_452e22: Could not read from the process.
legacy.could_not_write_to_the_707557: Could not write to the process.
legacy.count_your_and_and_add_21992f: Count your '{''{' and '}''}' and add the missing one. Keep each opening '{''{' at the end of the line that starts the block.
legacy.create_the_map_before_writing_a30: Create the map before writing to it: ages := make(map[string]int) or ages := map[string]int'{''{''}''}'.
legacy.creates_new_variables_every_varia: := creates new variables. Every variable on its left side already exists in this block, so there is nothing new to create.
legacy.deadlock_every_goroutine_is_waiti: Deadlock: every goroutine is waiting forever
legacy.delete_the_line_that_imports_ec21: Delete the line that imports "{package}", or use something from it.
legacy.delete_the_unreachable_lines_or_b: Delete the unreachable lines, or move them before the return.
legacy.do_you_want_to_save_c33382: Do you want to save changes to ''{name}'?
legacy.every_needs_a_matching_go_6f83e5: Every '{''{' needs a matching '}''}'. Go reached the end of the file, or of a block, while it was still waiting for one. Go also needs the opening '{''{' on the same line as func, if, for or else.
legacy.failed_to_start_go_make_0f023e: Failed to start Go. Make sure Go is installed and in your PATH.
legacy.folder_folder_no_go_mod_ee3b1a:
Folder: {folder}
No go.mod found. Create one to start a module.
legacy.go_cannot_find_the_package_0e6d83: Go cannot find the package "{package}". Standard packages have fixed names (fmt, math, strings, os...), and packages from the internet must be added to your module before you can import them.
legacy.go_could_not_understand_this_16ba: Go could not understand this line. It found {token} in a place where Go's grammar does not allow it. The real mistake is often just before that point.
legacy.go_does_not_know_anything_5d93df: Go does not know anything called "{name}". It was never declared, it is declared in a place this code cannot see (such as inside another function or block), or it is misspelled.
legacy.go_reported_count_problem_7f5a2b: {count, plural, one {Go reported {count} problem:} other {Go reported {count} problems:}}
legacy.go_version_used_to_run_d20c88: Go version used to run and build your programs.
legacy.gofmt_is_not_available_so_2cf86e: gofmt is not available, so the code is saved without formatting. {details}
legacy.gofmt_took_too_long_and_7ad67a: gofmt took too long and was stopped.
legacy.gopls_not_found_using_basic_48521: gopls not found: using basic completion
legacy.in_expression_the_two_sides_67d82: In {expression} the two sides have different types ({left_type} and {right_type}). Operators such as +, - or == only work between values of the same type.
legacy.in_go_only_names_that_af6602: In Go, only names that start with a capital letter can be used from another package. "{name}" starts with a lowercase letter, so package {package} keeps it private, or the real name has different capital letters.
legacy.install_go_or_set_its_4b8042: Install Go or set its path in Tools > Options > Environment.
legacy.interface_language_change_it_in_f: Interface language. Change it in Tools > Options > General.
legacy.look_right_before_the_marked_1743: Look right before the marked position for a missing comma, parenthesis, quote or operator.
legacy.make_sure_another_goroutine_recei: Make sure another goroutine receives what you send (go func() '{''{' ... '}''}'()), use a buffered channel, close the channel when you are done, or call wg.Done().
legacy.make_sure_that_0_start_7a358d: Make sure that 0 <= start <= end <= len(s) before slicing, for example with min(end, len(s)).
legacy.make_sure_the_pointer_gets_9a919f: Make sure the pointer gets a value before you use it, for example p := &Person'{''{''}''}' or p := new(Person), or check if p != nil first.
legacy.name_was_changed_outside_vizcacha:
''{name}' was changed outside VizcachaIDE and you have unsaved changes.
Reload it and lose your changes?
legacy.note_the_program_cannot_read_7fab: Note: the program cannot read keyboard input (stdin) while debugging.
legacy.nothing_to_explain_when_go_268a38: Nothing to explain. When Go reports an error, I will explain it here.
legacy.only_code_in_package_main_2671d7: Only code in package main can be run. The first line of this file declares a different package, which Go treats as a library.
legacy.open_a_folder_or_save_4997a4: Open a folder or save your file first.
legacy.open_a_folder_to_see_ebb351: Open a folder to see its files.
legacy.package_package_is_imported_but_0: Package "{package}" is imported but never used
legacy.pass_one_value_for_each_2af0a1: Pass one value for each parameter, in the same order and with the right types.
legacy.path_to_the_go_executable_5c6a3d: Path to the go executable (empty = PATH)
legacy.please_enter_a_module_path_474521: Please enter a module path, for example example.com/hello.
legacy.please_enter_a_package_for_270a8c: Please enter a package, for example github.com/google/uuid.
legacy.please_save_your_file_before_4efe: Please save your file before building.
legacy.please_save_your_file_before_5ec2: Please save your file before debugging.
legacy.remove_the_extra_values_so_6c9dc6: Remove the extra values so there is exactly one for each parameter.
legacy.restart_vizcachaide_to_apply_the_: Restart VizcachaIDE to apply the new language.
legacy.runs_gofmt_every_time_a_4ea234: Runs gofmt every time a .go file is saved.
legacy.slice_limits_bounds_are_out_8e4a5: Slice limits [{bounds}] are out of range
legacy.the_debugger_is_not_available_ec3: The debugger is not available yet. It will use Delve in a future version.
legacy.the_file_imports_the_package_ea6e: The file imports the package "{package}", but no code uses it. Go does not allow unused imports, to keep programs clean and fast to compile.
legacy.the_format_of_function_does_a40a8: The format of {function} does not match its values
legacy.the_format_text_given_to_c5ac6b: The format text given to {function} does not match the values after it. Each verb such as %d, %s or %v needs exactly one value, of a suitable type.
legacy.the_function_can_end_without_025b: The function can end without returning a value
legacy.the_function_function_needs_more_: The function {function} needs more values than you passed. In the original message, "have" lists what you passed and "want" lists what it expects.
legacy.the_function_function_receives_fe: The function {function} receives fewer values than you passed. In the original message, "have" lists what you passed and "want" lists what it expects.
legacy.the_installable_package_bundles_p: The installable package bundles PyQt5 (GPLv3), Go, Delve and gopls, so the distributed program is licensed under GPLv3. See NOTICE.md.
legacy.the_left_side_of_or_ee304a: The left side of = or := has {left} variable(s), but the right side gives {right} value(s). Both numbers must be equal. Many functions, such as strconv.Atoi, return two values: a result and an error.
legacy.the_map_variable_was_declared_fbe: The map variable was declared but never created, so it is nil. You can read from a nil map, but writing to it stops the program.
legacy.the_number_of_variables_and_fd6d1: The number of variables and values does not match
legacy.the_program_arguments_have_an_7e0: The program arguments have an unclosed quote.
legacy.the_program_asserted_that_a_adaef: The program asserted that a value holds a {type}, but it actually holds a {actual}. A failed assertion with a single result stops the program.
legacy.the_program_divided_an_integer_d1: The program divided an integer by zero (with / or %). That has no result, so Go stops the program.
legacy.the_program_has_no_main_f41e4a: The program has no main function
legacy.the_program_read_or_wrote_ad419d: The program read or wrote through a pointer (or an interface, map or slice element holding one) whose value is nil, so it points to nothing.
legacy.the_program_tried_to_take_bfc72e: The program tried to take the part [{bounds}] of a slice or string, but those limits go past its end, or the start is bigger than the end.
legacy.the_program_tried_to_use_26d3ff: The program tried to use position {index}, but the slice, array or string only has {length} element(s). Valid positions go from 0 to {length} - 1.
legacy.the_value_value_does_not_c8a028: The value {value} does not have the type {type}, which is what Go expects here. Go never converts between types such as int and string automatically.
legacy.the_variable_already_exists_use_e: The variable already exists: use = instead of :=
legacy.there_is_no_beginner_explanation_: There is no beginner explanation for this message yet. The text below is exactly what Go printed: searching for it on the web usually helps.
legacy.these_statements_come_after_a_08e: These statements come after a return, panic, break or infinite loop, so the program can never reach them.
legacy.this_file_is_not_a_d24175: This file is not a runnable program
legacy.this_function_says_it_returns_9c1: This function says it returns a value, but there is a way to reach its closing brace without a return statement. For example, an if returns a value but the case where the condition is false does not.
legacy.use_a_value_of_type_8108dc: Use a value of type {type}, or convert it explicitly, for example with int(x), float64(x) or strconv.Itoa(n).
legacy.use_custom_colors_instead_of_9ef7: Use custom colors instead of the theme colors
legacy.use_name_somewhere_for_example_c8: Use "{name}" somewhere (for example, print it), delete it, or replace it with _ if you must receive a value you do not need.
legacy.use_the_two_result_form_7bfb0c: Use the two-result form to check safely: n, ok := value.({type}). Or use a type switch.
legacy.use_to_change_the_value_24a363: Use = to change the value of an existing variable. Use := only the first time.
legacy.using_a_pointer_that_is_6c375b: Using a pointer that is nil
legacy.write_the_name_exactly_as_439e6c: Write the name exactly as the package documents it, starting with a capital letter (for example strings.ToUpper, not strings.toUpper).
legacy.writing_to_a_map_that_4887c2: Writing to a map that was never created
legacy.you_created_the_variable_name_0c4: You created the variable "{name}" but never read it. Go refuses to compile code with unused variables, because they are usually a mistake or leftover code.
